description: Deterministic rule-text integrity cases for the rules-text domain. Each case is a structural contract over <repoDir>/docs/portfolio/AGENTS.md, scored without any model, network or randomness. Cases carry a provenance object naming the documented statement they operationalize. The migration draft intentionally leaves documented gaps (two missing sections, one duplicated canonical fact) so the primary baseline is below 1.0 and one repaired case crosses floor 0.01 (1/caseCount >= 0.01).
